description: keying.rs static_edges emits StaticEdge::Lambda for LoweredStep::Lambda and nothing for LoweredStep::FunctionRef, though both mint a callable value naming a function. Fold the two into one construction edge. Witness: call/2 applying &pong/1 and &ping/1 is three singleton components today; after, ping and pong share one component and Recursive is true for both; a function reference closes over nothing so it does not consume callable identity. Built 2026-09-16 (canon identical over 548 fixtures) but held: on 00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref the newly visible edge main -> +/2 costs the component cone walk six more evaluations and raises three census pins (443 -> 454 job starts, trace budget 3062 > 3060, readiness-caused 9 of 11). It lands after fz-kdt.98.2 replaces that walk, so the pins move down or stay, never up. Second commit of fz-kdt.98.
title: A function reference is a construction edge of the call graph, as a lambda already is
